استعرفتا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْرَفَتَا (istaʕrafatā) /is.taʕ.ra.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# اُسْتُعْرِفَتَا (ustuʕrifatā) /us.tuʕ.ri.fa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
